sections.heading: Care that feels simple and honest.
paragraphs: Oryvia is a skincare and hair care brand inspired by traditional care, made for everyday routines.

sections.heading: Why we created Oryvia
paragraphs: Oryvia was started in [Rampur,UP] with a simple aim: to offer skincare and hair care that is easy to understand and easy to use.
We saw the high price of Skincare Products that inspire us to create a brand.
Today our range is small and focused. Every product has a clear purpose, a full ingredient list, and directions for use.

sections.heading: Our mission
paragraphs: To make skincare and hair care simple to understand and easy to follow, with clear ingredients and clear directions.

sections.heading: Our vision
paragraphs: To be a brand people trust for honest information and everyday care, one routine at a time.

sections.heading: A focused range
paragraphs: A small number of products, each with one clear job, instead of a long shelf to choose from.

sections.heading: Ingredient transparency
paragraphs: The full ingredient list is on the pack and on each product page, so you can check it yourself.

sections.heading: Clear guidance
paragraphs: Simple directions for use, plus a reminder to patch test before first use.

paragraphs: Questions about a product or an order? Message us and a real person will reply.

paragraphs: Start with Face Wash to wash the face.

sections.heading: Exfoliate
paragraphs: Use Scrub as directed on the pack.

sections.heading: Treat
paragraphs: Apply D-TAN as directed on the label.

sections.heading: Pamper
paragraphs: Use the 6 Step Facial Kit for a step-by-step facial.

sections.heading: Hair care
paragraphs: Choose Anti-Dandruff or Anti-Hairfall Shampoo.
Always follow the directions on each pack and patch test before first use.

sections.heading: Return & Refund Policy
paragraphs: We want you to receive the ORYVIA Care products you ordered in the expected condition. This policy explains how to contact us if an order arrives damaged, incorrect, defective, or otherwise has a problem.
Effective Date: 21 October 2026 · Website: oryviacare.in

sections.heading: 1. When Can I Request a Return or Refund?
paragraphs: You may contact us to request a return, replacement, or refund if your order is affected by an issue such as:
We will assess each request based on the facts, the information provided, the product type, and applicable law. Where appropriate, we may offer a replacement, refund, or another suitable resolution.
items: The product arrived damaged or leaked during delivery.
You received a product different from the one you ordered.
The product appears defective or was expired when delivered.
The product is materially different from its description or has another issue for which a remedy is available under applicable law.

sections.heading: 2. Time to Report an Issue
paragraphs: Please contact us within 48 hours of delivery if an order arrives damaged, incorrect, leaking, or visibly defective. This helps us investigate the issue promptly.

If you discover a problem later, or if a product is defective or otherwise eligible for a remedy under applicable law, please contact us as soon as reasonably possible. The reporting window above is a request for prompt notification and does not remove any non-excludable legal rights.

sections.heading: 3. Conditions for Returns
paragraphs: Where a return is appropriate and permitted, please keep the product and its packaging in a safe condition until we respond.

For hygiene and safety reasons, opened, used, or unsealed skincare and personal-care products may not be eligible for change-of-mind returns, except where a return, replacement, refund, or other remedy is required by law or is expressly offered by us.
items: Keep the product, outer packaging, and any included accessories where possible.
Do not discard the item before our support team has reviewed your request.
Share clear photographs or a short video if needed to show damage, leakage, incorrect items, or the relevant label and expiry details.
Keep your order number or purchase confirmation available.

sections.heading: 4. Items That May Not Qualify for a Change-of-Mind Return
paragraphs: Subject to applicable law and the remedies available for defective, damaged, incorrect, expired, or misdescribed products, the following may not be accepted for a change-of-mind return:
This section does not exclude legal remedies for product defects, safety issues, incorrect fulfilment, misleading descriptions, or other circumstances covered by applicable law.
items: Products that have been opened, used, or unsealed.
Products damaged after delivery due to misuse, improper storage, or handling unrelated to a product defect.
Orders where the customer has changed their mind, if the item is not covered by a voluntary return offer.

sections.heading: 5. How to Request a Return or Refund
paragraphs: We may request reasonable additional information needed to verify the order and assess the reported issue.
items: Contact us using the customer support details below, preferably from the email address or phone number associated with your order.
Provide your order number, the product name, and a short description of the issue.
Attach clear photographs or video where relevant, such as images of the damaged package, product, shipping label, or expiry information.
Wait for our team to review your request and provide return or resolution instructions. Please do not send an item to an address that has not been confirmed by our team.

sections.heading: 6. Refund Approval and Processing
paragraphs: If a refund is approved, it will generally be issued to the original payment method where possible, or through another appropriate method agreed with you and permitted by law.
Any applicable refund will be processed within the time required by law and the terms communicated when the refund is approved. If a refund is delayed, please contact us with your order number.
items: Prepaid orders: The refund will be initiated through the relevant payment provider or payment method, where supported.
Cash on Delivery orders: We may request suitable bank or digital payment details to process an approved refund. We will not ask for your card PIN, UPI PIN, OTP, or account password.
Processing time: The time taken for the amount to appear in your account may depend on the payment provider or bank. We will share the refund status where reasonably possible.

sections.heading: 7. Return Shipping Costs
paragraphs: If the return is due to an incorrect item, damage in transit, a verified product defect, or another issue attributable to us, we will explain the return or collection arrangement and handle reasonable return costs as required by our policy and applicable law.
For any voluntary change-of-mind return that we expressly permit, responsibility for return shipping costs will be communicated before the return is arranged.

sections.heading: Blackheads, Dullness and Tanning: Understanding What Your Skin Needs
paragraphs: Blackheads, dull-looking skin, and tanning are common skincare concerns. Although they can sometimes appear together, they are not the same thing.
Understanding the difference can help you choose a sensible routine instead of trying too many products at once.
At Oryvia Care, we believe that skincare should start with understanding your skin, not chasing unrealistic promises of instant results.

sections.heading: What Are Blackheads?
paragraphs: Blackheads are a type of acne lesion that forms when a hair follicle becomes blocked with oil and dead skin cells. The opening remains exposed to air, which contributes to its dark appearance.
Blackheads often appear on the nose, chin, and forehead.
To care for blackhead-prone skin, use a suitable gentle cleanser and avoid squeezing or picking at blocked pores. Aggressive scrubbing can irritate the skin and may worsen inflammation.
For persistent blackheads, ingredients such as salicylic acid may be helpful for some people. However, suitability varies, and a dermatologist can recommend an appropriate approach.

sections.heading: Why Does Skin Sometimes Look Dull?
paragraphs: Dullness is a description of how skin looks, rather than a specific medical condition. It can be associated with dryness, surface buildup, irritation, or uneven pigmentation.
A simple routine may help improve the appearance of dullness:
If dullness is accompanied by persistent irritation, a rash, or unusual skin changes, seek professional advice rather than relying only on cosmetic products.
items: Cleanse gently without stripping the skin.
Use a moisturizer suited to your skin type.
Avoid excessive exfoliation.
Apply sunscreen consistently during the day.
Give new products time to show whether they suit your skin.

sections.heading: What Causes Tanning?
paragraphs: Tanning is the skin’s response to ultraviolet radiation. It can happen after exposure to sunlight, including during everyday activities such as walking, travelling, or working outdoors.
A tan is a sign that the skin has responded to UV exposure. It should not be treated as a skin condition that can always be instantly removed with a cleanser or scrub.

The most important preventive step is sun protection. Use broad-spectrum sunscreen with SPF 30 or higher, follow its application instructions, reapply as directed, and seek shade when possible. Hats and protective clothing can provide additional help.

sections.heading: Can a Face Scrub Remove Blackheads and Tan?
paragraphs: A face scrub may help remove some dead cells from the skin’s surface and temporarily improve how smooth the skin feels.
However, it cannot guarantee the removal of blackheads, and aggressive scrubbing may irritate your skin. It also cannot reliably reverse a tan immediately.
If you use a face scrub, follow the instructions, apply it gently, and avoid using it on irritated skin. People with sensitive or acne-prone skin may need a different approach.
Persistent pigmentation or blackheads may respond better to targeted skincare ingredients or professional guidance than to frequent physical exfoliation.

sections.heading: Build a Balanced Skincare Routine
paragraphs: You do not need to treat every skin concern with a separate product. Start with a gentle cleanser, a suitable moisturizer, and daytime sun protection.
Add other products gradually, depending on your needs. Avoid combining multiple exfoliating products before understanding how your skin responds.
Remember that irritation can make skin concerns more noticeable, so maintaining the skin’s protective barrier is an important part of a balanced routine.

sections.heading: Discover Everyday Skin Care with Oryvia Care
paragraphs: Your skin deserves care that is consistent, thoughtful, and suited to your individual needs.

Oryvia Care offers face-care essentials, including face wash and face scrub options, to help you build a routine around everyday cleansing and personal care. Check each product’s ingredients and instructions to decide whether it is right for your skin.
Rather than aiming for a particular skin colour or an overnight transformation, focus on keeping your skin comfortable, protected, and healthy-looking.
Your natural skin deserves care, not unrealistic expectations.
Disclaimer: Individual results vary. Cosmetic products cannot guarantee the removal of blackheads, tanning, or pigmentation. Consult a dermatologist for persistent or worsening skin concerns.

sections.heading: Dandruff Care Guide: Everyday Habits for a Healthier-Feeling Scalp
paragraphs: White flakes on your shoulders, an itchy scalp, or visible scaling can make hair care frustrating. Dandruff is a common scalp concern, but it does not mean that you have poor hygiene.
The good news is that a thoughtful hair-care routine and an appropriate shampoo can help many people manage ordinary dandruff. Understanding what your scalp needs is the first step.

sections.heading: What Causes Dandruff?
paragraphs: Dandruff can have several contributing factors, including scalp oil, individual skin sensitivity, and the activity of naturally occurring microorganisms on the scalp.
Dryness can also cause flaking, but not every flaky scalp has the same cause. Conditions such as seborrhoeic dermatitis, psoriasis, and eczema can resemble dandruff.
That is why choosing products based on your symptoms, rather than relying on guesswork, matters.

sections.heading: Choose an Appropriate Anti-Dandruff Shampoo
paragraphs: If you frequently experience dandruff, consider a shampoo specifically formulated for dandruff care.

Depending on the product, an anti-dandruff shampoo may contain active ingredients such as ketoconazole, selenium sulfide, or zinc pyrithione where permitted. These ingredients serve different purposes, and the correct choice depends on the formulation and your needs.
Read the ingredient list and directions carefully. Medicated shampoos may have specific instructions about how much to use, how long to leave them on the scalp, and how frequently to apply them.
Do not assume that every shampoo marketed for dandruff contains the same active ingredients or works in the same way.

sections.heading: Wash Your Scalp Properly
paragraphs: Apply shampoo according to the label, focusing on the scalp rather than concentrating only on the lengths of your hair.
Massage gently with your fingertips. Avoid scratching with your nails, which can irritate the scalp.

Rinse thoroughly so that product residue does not remain on your scalp or hair. If your hair is long or dry, you may find it helpful to use conditioner on the lengths and ends, following the product instructions.

sections.heading: Avoid Common Hair-Care Mistakes
paragraphs: Scratching the scalp: Scratching may increase irritation and damage the skin.
Using too many products at once: Introducing several new treatments together makes it harder to identify what is helping or causing a reaction.
Assuming every flake is dandruff: Persistent scaling may have another cause and could require a different treatment.
Ignoring product instructions: Leaving a shampoo on longer than directed does not automatically improve the result.
Expecting instant relief: Scalp concerns can take time to improve, and results vary with the underlying cause and treatment.

sections.heading: When Should You Seek Professional Advice?
paragraphs: Consult a dermatologist if dandruff is severe, persistent, or accompanied by pronounced redness, swelling, sores, significant itching, or hair loss. You should also seek advice if an appropriate over-the-counter approach does not help.
Early assessment can help distinguish ordinary dandruff from other scalp conditions.

sections.heading: Find Your Hair-Care Routine with Oryvia Care
paragraphs: A comfortable scalp starts with consistent care and products that suit your needs.

Oryvia Care’s anti-dandruff shampoo can be considered as part of your hair-care routine. Check its ingredients and label directions to understand how it should be used. If the product is not a medicated treatment, persistent dandruff may require a shampoo containing an appropriate active ingredient or advice from a healthcare professional.
Give your scalp time, avoid unnecessary irritation, and keep your routine focused on what works for you.
Good hair care begins with caring for the scalp.
Disclaimer: This article is for general educational purposes and is not a medical diagnosis or treatment plan.

pages.title: How to Exfoliate Without Irritating Your Skin
pages.excerpt: Does your skin sometimes feel rough or look less fresh than usual? Exfoliation may be one part of your skincare routine to consider. A face scrub is a type of physical exfoliant that uses small particles to help remove some dead skin cells from the skin’s surface. When used appropriately, exfoliation can help skin feel […]

paragraphs: Does your skin sometimes feel rough or look less fresh than usual? Exfoliation may be one part of your skincare routine to consider.

A face scrub is a type of physical exfoliant that uses small particles to help remove some dead skin cells from the skin’s surface. When used appropriately, exfoliation can help skin feel smoother. However, too much scrubbing can cause irritation, redness, and dryness.
At Oryvia Care, we believe that self-care should feel comfortable, not harsh. Here is what to know before adding a face scrub to your routine.

sections.heading: What Does a Face Scrub Do?
paragraphs: Your skin naturally sheds dead cells over time. A face scrub can help loosen and remove some surface buildup through gentle physical exfoliation.
Depending on the formula and your skin, exfoliation may make the surface feel smoother and help temporarily improve the appearance of dullness.
However, a scrub cannot guarantee the removal of blackheads, permanently eliminate pigmentation, or instantly reverse tanning. These concerns may need different approaches.

sections.heading: How to Use a Face Scrub Correctly
paragraphs: Step 1: Begin with clean skin.
Follow the product instructions. If directed, gently cleanse your face first to remove sweat, oil, sunscreen, and everyday impurities.
Step 2: Wet your face.
Using water can help you apply some scrubs more comfortably. Follow the instructions for your particular product.
Step 3: Massage gently.
Apply the recommended amount and use light, circular movements without pressing hard. Avoid the delicate eye area and any broken, irritated, or inflamed skin.
Step 4: Rinse thoroughly.
Remove the product completely with lukewarm water. Do not keep scrubbing to make your skin feel extra smooth.
Step 5: Moisturize.
Follow with a suitable moisturizer. During the day, use sunscreen to protect your skin from sun damage.

sections.heading: How Often Should You Use a Face Scrub?
paragraphs: There is no universal schedule that works for everyone. Some people tolerate occasional exfoliation, while others experience irritation even with infrequent use.
Start conservatively and follow the product label. If your skin becomes tight, red, sensitive, or flaky, stop exfoliating until it settles.
Avoid combining a scrub with multiple other exfoliating products in the same routine unless you know your skin tolerates that combination.

sections.heading: Common Exfoliation Mistakes
paragraphs: Scrubbing harder for better results: More pressure does not mean better exfoliation.
Using a scrub every day: Frequent use may damage the skin’s protective barrier.
Scrubbing active breakouts: Inflamed acne can become more irritated with physical friction.
Ignoring sunscreen: Sun protection remains an important part of daytime skincare.
Expecting immediate transformation: Healthy-looking skin develops through consistent, suitable care rather than aggressive treatment.

sections.heading: Is a Face Scrub Suitable for Every Skin Type?
paragraphs: Not necessarily. People with sensitive skin, active eczema, rosacea, inflamed acne, or a weakened skin barrier may need to avoid physical scrubs or seek professional guidance first.
If you are unsure, consult a dermatologist about the safest approach for your skin.

sections.heading: Make Gentle Exfoliation Part of Your Oryvia Care Routine
paragraphs: A face scrub should complement your skincare routine, not replace cleansing, moisturizing, or sun protection.

Explore Oryvia Care’s face-care range and choose products according to your skin’s needs. Read the instructions carefully, use them as directed, and remember that gentle care is usually a better starting point than aggressive scrubbing.
Your skincare routine should leave your skin feeling cared for, not overworked.
Disclaimer: Product suitability varies. Follow the individual product label and discontinue use if irritation occurs.

sections.heading: How to Choose the Right Face Wash for Your Skin Type
paragraphs: A face wash is often the first step in a skincare routine, but choosing one can feel confusing. With so many formulas and product claims available, it is easy to wonder which cleanser is right for you.
The truth is that there is no single face wash that is perfect for everyone. Your skin type, personal preferences, and sensitivity all matter.
Here is how to make a more informed choice.

sections.heading: Face Wash for Oily Skin
paragraphs: Oily skin often produces excess sebum, which can leave the face looking shiny, particularly around the forehead, nose, and chin.
If your skin is oily, look for a cleanser designed to remove excess oil without leaving your face feeling excessively dry.
Washing your face too frequently or using harsh cleansers may irritate your skin and make it feel uncomfortable. Start with a gentle routine and observe how your skin responds.

sections.heading: Face Wash for Dry Skin
paragraphs: Dry skin may feel tight, rough, or flaky, particularly after cleansing.
A gentle cleanser that does not leave your skin feeling stripped is often a suitable choice. Avoid very hot water and excessive rubbing.
Follow cleansing with a moisturizer to help maintain hydration and keep your skin feeling comfortable.

sections.heading: Face Wash for Combination Skin
paragraphs: Combination skin typically has more oil in some areas and less moisture in others. For example, your forehead and nose may become oily while your cheeks feel normal or dry.
A balanced, gentle cleanser can be a useful starting point. Pay attention to how different areas of your face respond instead of assuming that your entire face has identical needs.

sections.heading: Face Wash for Sensitive Skin
paragraphs: Sensitive skin may react to certain fragrances, active ingredients, or cleansing formulas.

Look for products labelled for sensitive skin, review the ingredient list, and introduce new products carefully. A patch test can help identify possible irritation, although it cannot guarantee that a product will never cause a reaction.
Stop using any product that causes persistent burning, redness, or discomfort.

sections.heading: How Often Should You Wash Your Face?
paragraphs: For many people, cleansing once in the morning and once in the evening is a reasonable routine. However, your needs may differ depending on your skin type, exercise habits, and product use.
After sweating heavily, gently cleanse your skin when practical. Avoid repeatedly washing your face throughout the day unless there is a specific reason.

sections.heading: Common Face-Washing Mistakes to Avoid
paragraphs: Using very hot water: Lukewarm water is generally more comfortable and less likely to contribute to dryness.
Scrubbing too hard: Vigorous rubbing can irritate your skin. Use your fingertips and gentle movements.
Choosing products only for fragrance: A pleasant fragrance does not necessarily mean a formula is better suited to your skin.
Skipping moisturizer: Even oily skin can benefit from an appropriately selected moisturizer.
Expecting instant results: A face wash helps with cleansing, but concerns such as acne, pigmentation, and persistent irritation may require a more targeted approach.

sections.heading: Find Your Everyday Cleansing Essential with Oryvia Care
paragraphs: The right cleansing routine should leave your skin feeling clean and comfortable, not tight or irritated.
Oryvia Care encourages you to choose your products thoughtfully, pay attention to your skin’s response, and keep your daily routine simple.
Because good skincare is not about using the most products. It is about choosing the ones that work for your needs.
Disclaimer: This article provides general skincare information and does not replace professional medical advice.

sections.heading: The Ultimate Daily Skincare Routine for Healthy, Glowing Skin
paragraphs: Healthy-looking skin does not always require an elaborate routine or a shelf full of products. Often, the best approach is to keep things simple, choose products that suit your skin, and follow a consistent skincare routine.

At Oryvia Care, we believe that skincare should fit naturally into your everyday life. Whether you are managing a busy schedule, spending time outdoors, or simply looking for a little extra self-care, a few thoughtful steps can help you care for your skin.

sections.heading: Step 1: Start Your Day with a Gentle Face Wash
paragraphs: Throughout the day and night, your skin accumulates oil, sweat, and environmental impurities. Cleansing helps remove these unwanted residues and leaves your face feeling fresh.
Choose a face wash that suits your skin type. If your skin feels tight or uncomfortable after washing, your cleanser may be too harsh for you.
Use lukewarm water, gently massage the cleanser over your face, and rinse thoroughly. Avoid scrubbing vigorously, as this can irritate the skin.

sections.heading: Step 2: Keep Your Skin Moisturized
paragraphs: Moisturizing is an important step for most skin types, including oily skin. A suitable moisturizer helps maintain skin hydration and supports the skin’s natural protective barrier.
If you have oily skin, you may prefer a lightweight texture. If your skin is dry, a richer moisturizer may feel more comfortable.
Apply moisturizer according to the product instructions, ideally while your skin is slightly damp after cleansing.

sections.heading: Step 3: Make Sun Protection a Daily Habit
paragraphs: Sun exposure can contribute to tanning, uneven skin tone, premature skin ageing, and sun damage. Applying a broad-spectrum sunscreen with SPF 30 or higher is a useful daily habit.
Apply it to exposed skin before going outdoors, following the label instructions. Reapply as directed, especially after sweating, swimming, or spending extended periods outside.
Remember that sunscreen is useful even when the weather is cloudy.

sections.heading: Step 4: Follow a Simple Nighttime Routine
paragraphs: Your evening routine can be straightforward. Cleanse your face to remove sunscreen, makeup, sweat, and accumulated impurities. Follow with a moisturizer suited to your skin.
Avoid introducing several new skincare products at once. Giving your skin time to adjust makes it easier to identify which products work well for you.

sections.heading: Step 5: Do Not Forget Healthy Daily Habits
paragraphs: Skincare is not just about the products you apply. Try to maintain regular sleep, eat a balanced diet, drink enough water, and avoid picking at pimples or irritated skin.
Your skin’s needs can also change with the seasons, so adjust your routine when necessary.

sections.heading: Build Your Routine with Oryvia Care
paragraphs: A consistent skincare routine starts with understanding what your skin needs. A suitable cleanser, a moisturizer, and daily sun protection can provide a practical foundation without making skincare complicated.
Explore Oryvia Care for everyday personal-care essentials and make your routine a moment of care for yourself.
Healthy skin begins with small habits repeated every day.
Disclaimer: Individual skin needs and results vary. Patch-test new products when appropriate, follow product directions, and consult a dermatologist for persistent skin concerns.
